highlights: Built Raw Vault, Business Vault, and Clean Vault schemas in Snowflake across 5 insurance subject areas, directly powering regulatory reporting and executive BI dashboards
Executed 20+ schema deployments across Dev, QA, and Production via Jenkins and GitHub using XML-based master changelogs — zero failed deployments across the full release cycle
Wrote shell scripts to pull source files from AWS S3 and load into Snowflake over SSH, eliminating per-environment manual config and improving deployment reliability by 100%
Standardised the release workflow across two parallel tracks (GOALD and NAVINS) in DBVisualizer, cutting validation cycles by 35%
Mentored 3 junior engineers on Data Vault 2.0 design patterns and enterprise release governance

Led Unity Catalog migration for a 50TB Azure Databricks data lake — rebuilt all pipelines on Medallion Architecture (Bronze-Silver-Gold); pipeline execution time dropped 62.5% and production defects fell 98%
Rewrote 100+ Azure Data Factory pipelines using PySpark and SQL — data throughput increased 40% and latency dropped 50% for time-critical retail analytics feeds
Owned 10+ end-to-end production releases on Azure DevOps — all on schedule, none rolled back, with multi-stage automated testing catching issues before production
Worked with onshore QA teams to sign off each release against data accuracy, integrity, and SLA criteria across global retail operations
First responder for P1 incidents — closed 95% within SLA through root-cause analysis and permanent fixes, holding platform uptime at 99.9% across retail data systems
Built regression test frameworks for ETL/ELT pipelines — post-release failures dropped 40% and unplanned downtime fell noticeably across Databricks and ADF workloads
Delivered Power BI dashboards and automated ETL reports that cut manual reporting effort by 40% and reduced BI request turnaround time by 45%
Built Azure Data Factory pipelines for structured and semi-structured source data
Ran SQL-based data quality checks across Dev and UAT environments to support pipeline sign-off
